hedges.reason: When Iran or Hezbollah exchanges direct fire with Israel, Israel shuts its civilian airspace, as it did in the April 2024 and June 2025 rounds. That same war-cabinet emergency is the main reason Netanyahu would stay home and skip the late-September UNGA trip. A closure any time through September 30 covers that UNGA window.

If the US-Iran diplomatic track stalls through September 30, the June roadmap has probably broken down and regional escalation becomes more likely. Escalation is the state in which Netanyahu stays in Israel. This is a weaker, indirect link to the same crisis worlds.

claims.reason: Netanyahu's usual reason to miss UNGA is a live security emergency, most plausibly direct hostilities with Iran or its proxies. That kind of emergency reliably leads Israel to close its airspace broadly. A skip for purely political reasons (the campaign, coalition trouble) would break this claim, but I think that is the less likely route to a No.
